_readme: Settings for every LLM call. Each persona runs on its own provider ('providers' below, T16); until T18 the game still sends every ask to the Claude Messages API, as this paragraph says. The API keys are not here; they are in Local/llm_key.json (see Docs/llm_key.example.json). Request body: model, max_tokens, system (the joined system text), messages [{role: user, content: <state JSON as text>}], output_config {effort, format {type: json_schema, schema: reply_schema}}, plus fallbacks when it is not empty. Headers: x-api-key, anthropic-version (api_version), content-type: application/json, plus anthropic-beta when beta is not empty. Read the first content block whose type is text; stop_reason 'refusal' or 'max_tokens', or a top-level type 'error', is a failed ask. reply_schema is the one reply shape for every ask (scene turn, Free Talk line, vote, reaction, closing line, tiebreak, input conversion); unused fields come back empty. The schema can't cap words or list lengths, so the game cuts speech and reason to 25 words and uses at most 2 actions. relay: the relay address (Relay/README.md). Test for Free on the title screen (or "free_mode": true in Local/switches.json) sends every ask there with "free": true: no key, no tokens, pre-written replies from free_mode.json.

providers._readme: One entry per AI provider (T16). Each actor's ask goes to its persona's 'provider' (personas.json); roles.actor.provider 'persona' means that. The input LLM and the Director use the provider in their role, with the role's own model, effort and max_tokens. Until T18 the game still sends every ask to Anthropic with the top-level endpoint and the role's values; from T18 on it reads this block. The ids are the relay's provider ids (Relay/relay.config.json), so a relay request is {provider: <id>, session, body}, and the model must be on the relay's allow-list. key_field is the field in Local/llm_key.json that holds this provider's key; an empty key means its personas can't take a seat when the game calls providers directly. format 'anthropic' is the Messages API: headers x-api-key (the key) and anthropic-version (api_version); body {model, max_tokens, system, messages [{role: user, content: <state JSON>}], output_config {effort, format {type: json_schema, schema: reply_schema}}}; read the first content block whose type is text; stop_reason 'refusal' or 'max_tokens', or a top-level type 'error', is a failed ask. format 'openai_chat' is the Chat Completions shape these providers share: header Authorization: Bearer <key>; body {model, <max_tokens_field>: max_tokens, messages [{role: system, content: <system text>}, {role: user, content: <state JSON>}], response_format {type: json_schema, json_schema {name: reply, schema: reply_schema, strict: true}}, <effort_field>: effort}; read choices[0].message.content; finish_reason 'length' or 'content_filter', a non-empty choices[0].message.refusal, or a top-level 'error' object (error.message) is a failed ask (a relay error still has top-level type 'error'). Each effort is the cheapest the provider accepts, the same one the relay forces: meta rejects 'none', and its 'minimal' still spends about 70 reasoning tokens. No temperature: the reasoning models reject it or ignore it.
